14.t: The Kid Niki pcb has a 44 pin edge connector. Data East supplies a suitable EMI filter pcb with each game to make the game comply with FCC regulations and adapt to the Data East harness pin-out configuration.
Note that the pin-out configurations are quite different and under no circumstances should the harness edge connector be plugged directly on to the Kid Niki logic pcb.
